tissues.citation: Bevilacqua et al. 1999, in-vivo exposed human skull at 849 nm (mua 0.0215, musp 0.91 mm^-1); Matcher et al. 1997, intact-head in-vivo scattering fit evaluated at 810 nm (musp 0.9235 mm^-1)
tissues.conversion: Rounded in-vivo-nearby consensus: mua=0.021 mm^-1 and musp=0.92 mm^-1; mus=musp/(1-0.89).
tissues.tissue_definition: Colin27 skull represented by an in-vivo-first human cranial-bone estimate.
tissues.uncertainty: Absorption is a nearby 849-nm exposed-skull measurement; intact-head scattering is a layered homogeneous fit, and neither resolves cortical versus diploic bone.
tissues.notes: Primary scenario. Cassano and Pitzschke alternatives are explicit overlays in the scenario manifest.

tissues.citation: Cassano et al. 2019, Table 1, 810-nm skull row; project dura-proxy assumption
